items.name: Dad's cabin key
items.description: A small key for Dad's cabin.

items.name: Folded evacuation note
items.description: A folded note from the kitchen; readable in hand.

readable.title: A note from the kitchen
readable.text: If you're reading this, they took the sick south to the clinic. We went looking for Dad. Please don't wait for us.

readable.title: Hunter's logbook
readable.text: The deer ran straight at the fence instead of away from us. The dogs won't go near the creek. Something is wrong with the animals. Mike says his garage down the ridge road has fuel and a radio. I'm heading there at first light.

items.name: Medical pharmacy key
items.description: A key for the medical hall pharmacy.

readable.title: Sampling intake log
readable.text: The community hall became a temporary viral-sampling site after the first fever cases. We record each swab and compare the progression of symptoms; there is no treatment protocol yet. The military camp sends the sealed kits and replacement supplies. Keep the ward notes with the samples.
